summary: TIGA provides production-role FTE snapshots from 2016 to May 2024 and workforce counts including freelancers through September 2025. DCMS supplies a separate 2015-2025 annual jobs series, subject to substantial sampling uncertainty. Ukie surveys provide contractor and nationality shares; changing recruitment prevents treating share changes as national workforce changes.

limitations: TIGA excludes non-production commercial/administrative occupations and is not all game-company employment.
TIGA full report is paid; only public primary summary and methods inspected.
2025 contractor value is a strict lower bound, and no exact 2025 FTE was verified.
TIGA has no 2019 snapshot; do not fabricate a 2019 index baseline.
DCMS 2025 estimate is 58,000 jobs with a 95% interval of 46,000-71,000; it is not evidence that TIGA is wrong or that employment recovered. Different scope and sample uncertainty apply.
Ukie nationality percentages are self-reported sampled citizenship categories, not foreign ownership; 2021 multiple-nationality responses cannot be added into a foreign-only total.
No annual national contractor or nationality census established.
review_checks: Official WordPress JSON read for dated TIGA releases; body values separated from indirect impacts and forecasts.
2024 workforce arithmetic: 24,891 full-time roles + 3,625 freelancers = 28,516 people; FTE headline 25,419 kept separate.
ODS Computer Games classification checked in Table 1c and totals extracted from 2015-2025 worksheets; confidence intervals and suppression keys inspected.
Ukie survey dates and changing recruitment mix verified against methodological appendix.
